context.description: Slug of the top-level group that owns the component. Defaults to the input directory name.

service.description: Slug of the component that constructs the Redis client. Defaults to the input directory name.

store.description: Slug of the Redis store beneath the component.

name.description: Human-readable store name. Defaults to '<service> Redis'.

out.description: Name of the fragment file inside the step output directory.
